body_markdown:
## Overview

The iPad 6th Gen delivers the core iPad experience — a beautiful Retina display, smooth performance, and access to millions of iPad-optimised apps — at an accessible price point.

## Key Features

- **Display:** 9.7-inch Retina display with True Tone.
- **Chip:** A10 Fusion — suitable for basic tasks.
- **Apple Pencil Support:** Works with 1st gen Apple Pencil for note-taking and drawing.
- **Battery:** Up to 10 hours of battery life.

## The Verdict

The iPad 6th Gen is an affordable entry into the iPad ecosystem. Perfect for browsing, email, streaming, and basic note-taking.

Check out the iPad 6th Gen in the shop today.
